name: Sakuma Minori
source:
3rd-year and a member of the basketball team, a tomboy with short hair. Though she was the ace member of the team, she didn’t like leading others so she didn’t become the director. She has a calm personality, and is pretty close with [url=/c568]Amane[/url].

[From Shiori-chan's review]
